content: {"episode_id":"ep-05161","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-22","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-22 denial of CPT 93229 for episode ep-05161. The clinical indication note states the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia, supporting the submitted diagnosis codes I47.1 and R42. The note further documents a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, consistent with G45.9, and states that prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with these neurological symptoms and dizziness. On this documented indication, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring under CPT 93229 is medically necessary and we request reprocessing of the outstanding balance of 427.50."}
